content:
Rina: Hey team, quick one. My trip to Barcelona got delayed at passport control this morning (they held my passport for additional checks) so my train home was missed and I had to book a last-minute hotel + a same-day visa stamping/expedite fee to sort entry. Can Redwood reimburse the hotel + expedite fee? Also any special docs needed since the border stamp is digital and I only have an email from the control office and a receipt from the kiosk?

Sam: Sorry that happened! Yes, reimburseable as a travel disruption expense when it affects business travel. We need: itemized hotel folio for the additional night; receipt for the visa/expedite fee; proof of missed connection (train ticket showing original departure time or e-ticket with timestamp); and the official communication from the border authority that shows the check/hold. If the border provided only an email, that is acceptable.

Vanessa: Micro policy note: standard visa application fees for personal reasons are not reimbursable, but emergency/expedite fees incurred solely to enable business travel are covered with manager sign-off. Please upload manager approval (Slack screenshot or email) to the expense.

Rina: I paid the hotel and the expedite fee on my personal card because the company card wasn't activated in EUR. Is that fine?

Miguel: Finance confirms reimburse. Mark the expense memo as "PersonalCard-EUR-Expedite" and include last4. Convert the visa and hotel charges to USD in Expensify using the transaction date. If you have trouble with conversion, tag us and we'll help.

Rina: Border email attached (redacted name ok?), train e-ticket showing missed departure, and hotel folio uploading now. Manager (Vanessa) confirmed in DM and will screenshot.

Vanessa: Confirming here 026-04-02: approved emergency expedite reimbursement for Rina for Barcelona trip. Manager sign-off: Vanessa.

immigration-bot: Reminder: do not post passport numbers or full IDs in Slack. Acceptable proof: border authority email, stamped e-ticket, or kiosk receipt. Redact any sensitive numbers before upload.

expensify-bot: Draft expense created: 2052345678-RINA-BCN-DELAY. Missing docs: hotel folio, visa expedite receipt, manager approval screenshot. Note: auto-hold if any required doc is missing after 48 hours.

Rina: Thanks all 026-04-02 16:12. Uploading shortly. Quick Q: per-diem for the extra night or receipts?

Sam: For short disruption extensions (<24 hours) we often do actual receipts. For full extra nights, use actual receipts unless you pre-selected per-diem for the trip. Since this was unplanned and international, submit actual meal/hotel receipts. If small incidental receipts <$25 without receipts, finance will accept card statement detail plus a note.

Miguel: Once submitted, tag expense EXP-2052345678 and I'll route to expedited queue. Expect reimbursement within one payroll cycle after approval.

Rina: Uploaded everything and redacted passport numbers per bot. Thanks for the quick help.
